<?php
class AssertionsFloatOption105 {
    public string $id; public string $option;
    public function __construct($id,$option) {$this->id=$id;$this->option=$option;}
    public function __toString():string {echo "T:",$this->id,":",$GLOBALS["stage"],";";return $this->option;}
    public function __destruct() {ini_set("precision",1);echo "D:",$this->id,":",ini_get("zend.assertions"),":",ini_get("precision"),";";}
}
class AssertionsFloatTemporary105 implements Iterator {
    public int $pos=0; public AssertionsFloatOption105 $name;
    public function __construct() {$this->name=new AssertionsFloatOption105("A","zend.assertions");}
    public function rewind():void {echo "W;";$this->pos=0;}
    public function valid():bool {echo "V",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos<2;}
    public function current():mixed {echo "C",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos===0?$this->name:1.4;}
    public function key():mixed {echo "K",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos;}
    public function next():void {echo "N",$this->pos,";";$this->pos++;if($this->pos===2){$GLOBALS["stage"]="done";}}
    public function __destruct() {echo "I:",ini_get("zend.assertions"),";";}
}
function makeFloat105() {$it=new AssertionsFloatTemporary105;$GLOBALS["watch"]=WeakReference::create($it);return $it;}
$stage="walk";$watch=null;echo "B;";
$result=ini_set(...makeFloat105());echo "R:",$result,":",ini_get("zend.assertions"),":",ini_get("precision"),":",($watch->get()===null?1:0),";";
unset($watch);ini_restore("zend.assertions");ini_restore("precision");echo "E:",ini_get("zend.assertions"),":",ini_get("precision"),";";
purpose: Stringable option destruction changes precision from 14 to 1 before copied float 1.4 is stringified for zend.assertions; temporary owners retire first, old return and restore stay correct.

    public function __toString():string {echo "T:",$this->id,":",$GLOBALS["stage"],";";return $this->option;}
    public function __destruct() {ini_set("precision",1);echo "D:",$this->id,":",ini_get("zend.assertions"),":",ini_get("precision"),";";}
}
class AssertionsFloatValues105 implements Iterator {
    public int $pos=0;
    public function rewind():void {echo "W;";$this->pos=0;}
    public function valid():bool {echo "V",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos<2;}
    public function current():mixed {echo "C",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos===0?$GLOBALS["name"]:1.6;}
    public function key():mixed {echo "K",$this->pos,";";if($this->pos===0){$GLOBALS["name"]=new AssertionsFloatSelectedOption105("B","display_errors");$GLOBALS["call"]=ini_get(...);}return $this->pos;}
    public function next():void {echo "N",$this->pos,";";$this->pos++;if($this->pos===2){$GLOBALS["stage"]="done";}}
}
$stage="walk";$name=new AssertionsFloatSelectedOption105("A","zend.assertions");$it=new AssertionsFloatValues105;$call=ini_set(...);$keep=$call;echo "B;";
$result=$call(...$it);echo "R:",$result,":",ini_get("zend.assertions"),":",ini_get("precision"),":",$name->id,":",$call("zend.assertions"),":",$keep("zend.assertions",0),":",ini_get("zend.assertions"),";";
unset($it,$name,$call,$keep);ini_restore("zend.assertions");ini_restore("precision");echo "E:",ini_get("zend.assertions"),":",ini_get("precision"),";";
purpose: Selected setter and copied float 1.6 survive key-time callable/option rebinding; option retirement changes precision before float conversion, then retained setter writes 0 and restore returns startup settings.
